description_en: Queries the list of OTA modules for a product
description_zh: 调用该接口查询产品下的OTA模块列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-ota-module-by-product --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --product-key a1uctKe0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOTAModuleByProduct

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
